subject: ACME Payments: marketplace metering discrepancy and onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Raj Singh <raj.singh@acmepayments.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@acmepayments.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy in marketplace metering + hold request for co-sell

Hi Sofia,

We completed the marketplace onboarding steps yesterday, but our finance team flagged unexpectedly high trial metering numbers for the month-to-date in the billing report (attached). The numbers look like usage from multiple projects rolled into a single SKU and that’s inflating the reported trial credits.

Before we go live with the co-sell push and synced listing, can you pause any promotional co-sell campaigns and marketplace featured placements? We want to avoid being promoted with incorrect usage data.

Quick ask: can your team validate how Redwood’s metering maps GCP billing rows to marketplace SKUs? I’ve attached the CSV export and a screenshot.

Thanks,
Raj Singh
Head of Cloud Partnerships
ACME Payments
Attachment: metering_report_may.csv (CSV stub)
Attachment: gcp-partner-console-screenshot.png (PNG stub)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Raj Singh <raj.singh@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in marketplace metering + hold request for co-sell

Hi Raj — thanks for the heads up and the files. I’ve paused outbound co-sell promotions on our side pending a quick verification.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Ben (billing) will triage the CSV and confirm whether rows are being aggregated incorrectly.
- Olga (co-sell ops) will review listing entitlements and make sure SKU mapping matches your intended project granularity.
- I’ll coordinate with Vivek on any temporary UI/portal flags we should flip to prevent syndication.

Can you confirm which project IDs should be excluded from trial reporting and whether there are partner-managed billing projects we should ignore? I’ll set up a short 30-min call for tomorrow morning.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: co-sell-sla-draft.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Raj Singh <raj.singh@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in marketplace metering + hold request for co-sell

Raj, Sofia — I pulled the CSV. Short summary: there are three distinct GCP project IDs in the export but our ingestion pipeline currently maps them all to a single marketplace SKU because they share the same billing account. That mapping is intended for most ISVs, but in your case you were expecting per-project breakouts.

Immediate remediation plan:
1) Short-term: we will exclude the two internal staging projects you identify from trial aggregation within 24 hours so your visible trial numbers align with production usage.
2) Mid-term: implement per-project SKU tagging for your listing (requires a small config change on our metering service and a listing re-publish). Planned timeline: 5 business days once we have the allowed project IDs.
3) I’ll circulate a sanitized CSV after exclusions so you can verify.

Can you send the two project IDs we should exclude? Also flag any sub-accounts that are partner-billed.

— Ben Carter
Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment: (metering_report_may_analyzed.csv stub)

From: Raj Singh <raj.singh@acmepayments.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@acmepayments.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in marketplace metering + hold request for co-sell

Thanks, Ben. Project IDs to exclude are: proj-staging-42 and proj-internal-99. There is also a partner-managed test project (partner-test-01) that should remain visible but not counted towards trial credits — curious if Redwood supports a partner-exempt flag.

We also spotted a mismatch in the SLA draft around revenue share reporting frequency — we prefer monthly reporting on meter usage. I’ve attached comments in the PDF.

Raj

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Raj Singh <raj.singh@acmepayments.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in marketplace metering + hold request for co-sell

Raj — we can support a partner-exempt classification for partner-managed test projects; it will keep them visible in the listing portal but exclude them from trial aggregation and revenue calculations. Ben and I will push the short-term exclusion for proj-staging-42 and proj-internal-99 by EOD.

Olga’s immediate action items:
- Apply exclusions (EOD) and send sanitized CSV for Raj to validate.
- Update the co-sell SLA draft to specify monthly metering reports and include a clause for partner-exempt projects.
- Schedule a 30-min verification call tomorrow at 10:00 AM PT to confirm the sanitized export and re-open the co-sell pipeline after Raj signs off.

Thanks — we’ll follow up with the sanitized file and the updated SLA link (DocuSign) once done.

— Olga Petrov
Co-sell Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: updated-action-items.md (text stub)
